description: This file defines a singleton object 'DummyData' that provides mock data for a media application, including categories, a catalog of VOD (Video On Demand) items, channel lists, and a method to generate simulated Electronic Program Guide (EPG) data.

classes.name: DummyData
classes.description: A singleton object providing mock media data including categories, VOD catalog, channels, and EPG generation.

methods.name: generateEpg
methods.description: Generates scheduled program data for channels over a specified number of hours with fixed slot durations.
